mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_group (id, name, description, created_by, created_at, updated_at, settings_json) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{settingsJson})
mapper.select: SELECT id, name, description, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt, image_url AS imageUrl, settings_json AS settingsJson FROM study_group WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.description, g.created_by AS createdBy, g.created_at AS createdAt, g.updated_at AS updatedAt, g.image_url AS imageUrl, g.settings_json AS settingsJson FROM study_group g JOIN study_member m ON g.id = m.study_id WHERE m.user_email = #{userEmail}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_member (id, study_id, user_email, role, joined_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{studyId}, #{userEmail}, #{role}, #{joinedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT sm.id, sm.study_id AS studyId, sm.user_email AS userEmail, sm.role, sm.joined_at AS joinedAt, u.name AS userName, u.nickname AS userNickname FROM study_member sm LEFT JOIN users u ON u.email = sm.user_email WHERE sm.study_id = #{studyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_invite (id, study_id, inviter_email, invitee_email, status, invited_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{studyId}, #{inviterEmail}, #{inviteeEmail}, #{status}, #{invitedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT i.id, i.study_id AS studyId, i.inviter_email AS inviterEmail, i.invitee_email AS inviteeEmail, i.status, i.invited_at AS invitedAt, g.name AS studyName FROM study_invite i JOIN study_group g ON i.study_id = g.id WHERE i.invitee_email = #{inviteeEmail} AND i.status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY i.invited_at DESC
SELECT id, study_id AS studyId, inviter_email AS inviterEmail, invitee_email AS inviteeEmail, status, invited_at AS invitedAt FROM study_invite WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE study_invite SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shared_essay (id, study_id, user_email, workspace_id, version_ids, latest_added_version_ids, shared_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{studyId}, #{userEmail}, #{workspaceId}, #{versionIds}, #{latestAddedVersionIds}, #{sharedAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT se.id, se.study_id AS studyId, se.user_email AS userEmail, se.workspace_id AS workspaceId, se.version_ids AS versionIds, se.latest_added_version_ids AS latestAddedVersionIds, se.shared_at AS sharedAt, se.updated_at AS updatedAt, c.name AS companyName, j.title AS positionTitle, j.deadline_label AS deadlineLabel FROM shared_essay se LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = se.workspace_id LEFT JOIN basket_jobs bj ON bj.id = w.basket_job_id LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = bj.job_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE se.study_id = #{studyId} ORDER BY se.shared_at DESC

SELECT se.id, se.study_id AS studyId, se.user_email AS userEmail, se.workspace_id AS workspaceId, se.version_ids AS versionIds, se.latest_added_version_ids AS latestAddedVersionIds, se.shared_at AS sharedAt, se.updated_at AS updatedAt, c.name AS companyName, j.title AS positionTitle, j.deadline_label AS deadlineLabel FROM shared_essay se LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = se.workspace_id LEFT JOIN basket_jobs bj ON bj.id = w.basket_job_id LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = bj.job_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE se.study_id = #{studyId} AND se.user_email = #{userEmail} AND se.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} LIMIT 1

SELECT se.id, se.study_id AS studyId, se.user_email AS userEmail, se.workspace_id AS workspaceId, se.version_ids AS versionIds, se.latest_added_version_ids AS latestAddedVersionIds, se.shared_at AS sharedAt, se.updated_at AS updatedAt, c.name AS companyName, j.title AS positionTitle, j.deadline_label AS deadlineLabel FROM shared_essay se LEFT JOIN workspaces w ON w.id = se.workspace_id LEFT JOIN basket_jobs bj ON bj.id = w.basket_job_id LEFT JOIN jobs j ON j.id = bj.job_id LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = j.company_id WHERE se.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO essay_feedback (id, shared_essay_id, author_email, content, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{sharedEssayId}, #{authorEmail}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, shared_essay_id AS sharedEssayId, author_email AS authorEmail, content, created_at AS createdAt FROM essay_feedback WHERE shared_essay_id = #{sharedEssayId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shared_job (id, study_id, recommender_email, company_name, position_title, deadline_label, deadline_date, source_url, reason, recommended_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{studyId}, #{recommenderEmail}, #{companyName}, #{positionTitle}, #{deadlineLabel}, #{deadlineDate}, #{sourceUrl}, #{reason}, #{recommendedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT sj.id, sj.study_id AS studyId, sj.recommender_email AS recommenderEmail, sj.company_name AS companyName, sj.position_title AS positionTitle, sj.deadline_label AS deadlineLabel, sj.deadline_date AS deadlineDate, sj.source_url AS sourceUrl, sj.reason, sj.recommended_at AS recommendedAt, u.name AS recommenderName FROM shared_job sj LEFT JOIN users u ON sj.recommender_email = u.email WHERE sj.study_id = #{studyId} ORDER BY sj.recommended_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE study_group SET image_url = #{imageUrl} WHERE id = #{studyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO study_essay_read_log (study_id, essay_id, user_email, read_at) VALUES (#{studyId}, #{essayId}, #{userEmail}, #{readAt})
